title: MCmisidechat-仿米塔风格字幕
description: A subtitle mod suitable for map making
body:
[Video link](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV18kdLBNEEq) ### Overview MCmisidechat is a creates subtitles in miside style Great for cutscenes, command maps, stream events, and server announcements. ### Key Features - Per-character pop-in reveal animation - Staggered character drop sequence - Ground behavior: flat landing + shrink/fade out - Styling support: You can use hexadecimal colors - Player-view spawn: generate subtitle 2 blocks in front of a target player ### Commands ```mcfunction /msc [x] [y] [z] [rot1] [rot2] [text] [holdSeconds] /mscplayer [player] [text] [holdSeconds] ``` Notes: - `holdSeconds` is optional and controls how long text stays before dropping - `/mscplayer` uses the target player's current yaw/pitch and eye direction ### Inline Styling Tags ```text <66ccff> or <#66ccff> Set hex color Set glyph size (10 = baseline) Enable bold
Line break ``` Examples: ```mcfunction /msc ~ ~2 ~ 0 0 <66ccff>Hello World 2.5 /mscplayer Steve Warning! 3 ``` ### Compatibility - Minecraft: `1.20.1` - Forge: `47.2.0+` - Java: `17` - Installation side: recommended on both client and server ### Changelog (v1.0.0) - Added `/mscplayer` command - Improved drop animation smoothness ### Known Issues - Very long text may cause minor frame drops on low-end machines - Some rare font combinations can still show slight offsets at extreme camera angles [视频链接](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV18kdLBNEEq) ### 简介 MCmisidechat 是一个沉浸式字幕动画模组，仿造米塔风格字幕制作 适合：剧情演出、指令地图、直播整活、服务器活动提示。 ### 核心特性 - 逐字弹出：每个字符依次出现并带有轻微放大动画 - 逐字掉落：字符按顺序分批掉落到地面 - 地面表现：落地后平躺并逐渐缩小消失 - 样式支持：兼容十六进制颜色代码 - 视角生成：支持在目标玩家当前视角前方 2 格生成字幕 ### 指令 ```mcfunction /msc [x] [y] [z] [rot1] [rot2] [text] [holdSeconds] /mscplayer [player] [text] [holdSeconds] ``` 参数说明： - `holdSeconds` 可选，控制字幕掉落前停留时间（秒） - `/mscplayer` 会使用目标玩家的当前朝向，并在其视角前方约 2 格生成字幕 ### 文本样式标签 ```text <66ccff> 或 <#66ccff> 设置颜色 设置字号（10 为基准） 粗体
换行 ``` 示例： ```mcfunction /msc ~ ~2 ~ 0 0 <66ccff>你好世界 2.5 /mscplayer Steve 警告！ 3 ``` ### 兼容信息 - Minecraft: `1.20.1` - Forge: `47.2.0+` - Java: `17` - 安装：建议客户端与服务端都安装 ### 本版本更新（v1.0.0） - 新增 `/mscplayer` 指令 - 优化掉落动画流畅度 ### 已知问题 - 极长文本在低性能环境下可能有轻微掉帧 - 特殊字体组合在极端视角下可能出现少量偏移
